name: open-test-file
description: Open test file corresponding to the active file (TypeScript/TSX and Java) using Command+Shift+T

keybindings.when: editorTextFocus && (resourceLangId == typescript || resourceLangId == typescriptreact || resourceLangId == java)

openTestFile.enabled.description: Enable/disable the Open Test File extension

openTestFile.typescriptTestPattern.description: Test file naming pattern for TypeScript files. Use {name} for the base filename and {ext} for extension.

openTestFile.javaTestPattern.description: Test file naming pattern for Java files. Use {name} for the base filename.

openTestFile.searchScope.description: Scope for searching test files: 'workspace' searches the entire workspace, 'sameDirectory' searches only in the same directory as the source file.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.package: npm run compile && vsce package --out open-test-file.vsix
